messages.subject: Carthagene Vs R/QTL
parts:
Hi,

I would like to construct a linkage map. How does R/QTL compares with CarthaGene and ASMap?
How many markers it can handle? How does it address heterozygous genotypes?

Thanks,
yk

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Carthagene Vs R/QTL
parts:
R/qtl has no hard limit on the number of markers, but things can get slow with a lot of markers.
I've no experience with CarthaGene and haven't made any comparisons to ASMap.

Heterozygous genotypes in an RIL population are omitted. hets in a backcross or F2 intercross are handled in the usual way.

karl
